name: Monitor scheduled n8n workflows and email missed or failing runs with SMTP

parameters.content:
## Monitor scheduled n8n workflows and email missed or failing runs
Daily check that your scheduled workflows actually ran. A failing workflow triggers your error workflow. A workflow that silently stops running triggers nothing - this one catches it.

### How it works
1. Loads all active workflows and reads the rhythm from each Schedule Trigger (interval, weekdays or cron). The largest gap between two runs becomes the threshold, so Mon-Fri schedules don't alarm on weekends.
2. Loads the last 50 executions of each watched workflow. Manual runs never count.
3. Reports OVERDUE, NO_SUCCESS, ERROR_RATE (more than 20% of at least 5 runs failed in 7 days, one of them in the last 24h) and SLOW (latest run more than 3x the median and over 60s).
4. Sends one email, only when there is something to report. Workflows that could not be assessed are listed in that email.

### Setup
1. Create an n8n API key (Settings > n8n API) and add it as an n8n API credential in *Fetch Active Workflows* and *Fetch Last 50 Executions*.
2. Add an SMTP credential to *Dispatch Report Email*.
3. Fill in notifyTo and notifyFrom in *Set Configuration Values*.
4. Set your error workflow in the workflow settings.
5. Run once manually, then activate.

### Customization
- overrides (JSON): watch webhook or sub-workflows too, or tune one workflow, for example {"Order webhook": {"maxGapHours": 48}}.
- ignoreNamePattern: skip workflows by name.
- executionRetentionDays: set it to your instance value. Longer rhythms are listed as not assessed.

Limits: workflows that don't save successful executions can't be assessed, and the watchdog can't report its own absence.

## Trigger and configuration
Runs daily or manually. All settings live in one node.

## Watch list
Reads active workflows and derives the expected gap from each Schedule Trigger.

## Check executions
One API call per watched workflow, then OVERDUE, NO_SUCCESS, ERROR_RATE and SLOW are evaluated.

## Report
Email only when there is a finding. Workflows that could not be assessed are listed at the bottom.
